```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r
      on r.rate_date = c.rate_date
     and r.currency = 'USD'
),
authorized_attempts as (
    select a.attempt_id,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           row_number() over (
               partition by coalesce(a.gateway_payment_id, a.attempt_id)
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as auth_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    where not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and a.status = 'authorized'
      and a.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
)
select null as key,
       cast(coalesce(round(sum(a.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting)), 0) as bigint) as value
from authorized_attempts a
join fx
  on fx.currency = a.currency
 and fx.rate_date = a.business_date
where a.auth_rank = 1
order by value
```
